item.title: Nokuthula Fundama shares new EP ahead of free Heritage concert in Joburg
item.description: By Tshifhiwa Mungoni, Sibongile Kobo, Axolile Lucky Mke, Lucky Maile and Lebogang Masilela South African artist Nokuthula Fundama has released her new EP, Siyaphambili, now available on all major streaming platforms. The project has received positive attention across various media outlets, highlighting Fundama’s ongoing influence as both a recording and performing artist. Following the release, Fundama will present a live concert titled The Journey – An African Heritage and Cultural Celebration

item.title: SA: Just Bheki’s feature on Emanonini hits over one million streams
item.description: By Matlhodi Molokomme and Lerato Mpho Ramogase South African vocalist, songwriter, and dancer Just Bheki has been credited for his performance on Zani’s latest single, ‘Emanonini’, which has exceeded one million streams across digital platforms. Born in KwaMashu, Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, Just Bheki has built a multi-faceted career as a vocalist, composer, and award-winning dancer. item.title: Music Business Academy to host workshop on distribution, publishing
item.description: The Music Business Academy (MBA), in partnership with SAMRO, will host a workshop in Sandton, Johannesburg on 26 February. The event will focus on music distribution, publishing, and Artists & Repertoire (A&R). The session will bring emerging practitioners into direct engagement with industry executives. item.title: Montreux Jazz Festival launches first African edition in SA
item.description: The Montreux Jazz Festival will make its African debut in Franschhoek, South Africa from 27 to 29 March, featuring a diverse line-up of African legends, international stars and emerging talent. The festival is held annually in Montreux, Switzerland, in early July along the shores of Lake Geneva. It is the world’s second-largest annual jazz festival, after the Montreal International Jazz Festival in Canada. item.description: MTN Bushfire, in partnership with the Africa Rising Music Conference (ARMC), has opened applications for the 2026 edition of the Arts Round Table (ART). item.title: Open call: Future Imaginations Festival 2026/2027 in Uganda
item.description: Future Imaginations Festival has opened an international call for artists to participate in its upcoming edition, scheduled to take place from 31 December 2026 to 2 January 2027 at the Bayimba Centre on Lunkulu Island, Uganda. The festival brings together artists, communities and innovators to reflect on the past year and explore future-facing ideas through creative and technological practice. item.title: Virgin Music Group completes acquisition of Downtown Music Holdings
item.description: Virgin Music Group (VMG) has completed its acquisition of Downtown Music Holdings, the company confirmed on 20 February. The transaction follows approval from the European Commission, granted on 13 February, subject to Universal Music Group (UMG) divesting Downtown’s Curve royalty accounting business. item.title: Spotify marks five years in Nigeria as local listening, discovery accelerate
item.description: Data received from Spotify indicate that music consumption in Nigeria has expanded sharply since the streaming service launched in the country in February 2021. Over the five-year period to 2025, year-on-year listening grew at an average rate of 163.5%, driven by sustained increases following triple-digit gains in the platform’s early years. item.title: SA: Freshlyground shares third single from forthcoming album
item.description: South African band Freshlyground has released ‘Take Me Home’, the third single from its upcoming album of the same name. The track marks a shift in the group’s sound, introducing a blues-influenced and soul-led approach that differs from its earlier Afropop-driven releases. The single features 20-year-old vocalist Mbali Makhoba, who has joined the band as lead singer. item.title: Suno appoints Jeremy Sirota as chief commercial officer
item.description: Music company Suno has appointed Jeremy Sirota as its chief commercial officer. Sirota, who previously served as CEO of Merlin, will oversee Suno’s commercial strategy, platform partnerships, music industry relationships, and enterprise solutions, reporting directly to CEO Mikey Shulman. Sirota’s career spans leadership roles across music, technology, and law.
